Three weeks with no answer isn't good enough, and I'm sorry. A PSU on a unit that ran three minutes is a straight replacement, no return of the miner needed.

I've pinged Abel and Georges on this chat now, so stay with me a few minutes and one of them will jump in here to get the PSU moving. If you step away, the answer comes to you by email.

On the new unit, happy to talk specs or stock whenever you want.
The unit powers on, but the speed goes up and down and i can't connect vie WI fi.

Both of those point back at the PSU. When it sags, the chip throttles and the wifi radio drops with it, so the speed swings and the connection won't hold.

One thing to rule out: the NerdOctaxe only joins a 2.4GHz network, not 5GHz. If your router broadcasts one combined name, split it or use the 2.4 band and retry.

Does it stay connected if you keep it near the router?
